text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~...
So that's Air Shakur...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...Doesn't she seem seriously unhinged?
Let's stop messing with her...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as it was within the academy, to other people's eyes,
Air Shakur seemed a bit eccentric.
Even so, however...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why... questions arise. Air Shakur is without a doubt a girl possessing top-class talent among her generation."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And yet, why did Parcae deduce that she would not win?
Almost as if—it was intentionally testing her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon returning, Air Shakur immediately sat
at his PC and began punching the race results
into Parcae.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...It stayed within the margin of error.
As expected, the accuracy of 'Parcae' is remarkably high."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Still...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
My heart rate stayed higher
than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't phrase it weirdly.
A state of excitement can be broken down into numerical data, too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Uncertain things like emotions have lousy
cost-performance when converted directly into data.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ain't that obvious? But collecting the data
to break that down into numerical values and proving it
takes an absurd amount of time.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: On top of that, the conditions are so restrictive it rarely produces usable results. The cost-performance is just garbage.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Then sort the direction of the emotions,
and shrink anything that can't be categorized.
That way, the data purity remains higher.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...We should gather the data again
by having her run starting from an elevated heart rate.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Either way, I've got a feel for the real race's atmosphere.
No problems left.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
For our next target race...
the Hopeful Stakes, the plan is to make the board.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Hopeful Stakes"— A prestigious GⅠ race restricted to Junior-tier Umamusume; those who perform well here carry high expectations into the Classic tier.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
From here on, we'll build up our stats all at once
to ensure we can claim the Double Crown.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The catalyst to change that 7 cm might just be waiting there, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly realize something. There's a difference at the wire...
Meaning there was a girl who won by a mere 7 centimeters.
choice_data_list: I wonder who that 7 cm difference is with.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Beats me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much data I fed in,
that rival remained nothing more than a shadow.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If I knew that, the calculations would've
been a whole lot simpler, though.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The only thing that's set in stone
is losing to someone by 7 centimeters. That's all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, I gotta collect more data before the Hopeful Stakes."
